evidence: Route: explicit code labels + data corroboration. comp-questions.xlsx keys wording by text number and question column q1..q4, the same (trialid/number, QUESTIONNUM) the IRW code is built from; derivation re-run offline reproduces 708/708 live codes. (1) Leave-one-site-out correlation of per-question accuracy on the 20 shared matched-text items across the 13 wave-1 sites: median r = 0.803 (range 0.66 gr - 0.94 en), vs a within-text shuffle of q: null mean 0.338, max 0.525 over 300 draws -- QUESTIONNUM indexes the same translated question in every sheet. (3) Marker: Norwegian wave-1 readers answered no_text6_q1/q2/q3 42/42/42 times and q4 0 times, matching the sheet's defective q4 (duplicate of q3, opposite key) and the readme's 47 questions; no_text6_q4 ships blank. (4) Marker: Spanish sheet text-3 q3 repeats q4; Spanish accuracy sp_text3_q3 0.479 vs text3_q4 0.521, against 0.930 for text3_q3 at the other wave-1 sites. A yes-key vs no-key accuracy test was tried and is uninformative at item level (diff 0.018 vs shuffle-null mean 0.019, p = 0.53), so not used. NOT established: the data do not pin each item's wording individually -- a permutation of q common to every sheet would pass (1), and (3)/(4) pin only two cells; the label tie carries the rest. Nothing verifies the 317 wave-2-only items (no wording shipped) or the script's assumption that wave-2 sites reusing a wave-1 text (no, tr, en_uk, German text 8) reused its questions.
